objs.name: document
objs.description: Central managed object representing policies, guidelines, procedural instructions, work instructions and other controlled documents in the system.

attributes.name: document_type
attributes.description: Classification of the document (e.g. policy, guideline, procedural instruction, work instruction).

attributes.name: document_level
attributes.description: Hierarchical level in the document pyramid the document belongs to.

attributes.name: document_abbreviation
attributes.description: Type abbreviation and consecutive number identifying the document (e.g. RL_0001).

attributes.name: version
attributes.description: Current version number of the document.

attributes.name: status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the document (e.g. editing, released, out of force, archived).

attributes.name: valid_from
attributes.description: Date from which the released document version is valid.

attributes.name: valid_until
attributes.description: Date until which the document version remains valid.

attributes.name: period_of_extended_validity
attributes.description: Configurable period (default 3 years) after which validity must be re-checked.

attributes.name: archive_duration
attributes.description: Configurable period (default 10 years) after which archived documents are physically deleted.

attributes.name: scope
attributes.description: Area of validity or relevant companies for the document.

attributes.name: references
attributes.description: Links to other documents, master data or IT applications.

attributes.name: it_applications
attributes.description: IT applications referenced by the document.

attributes.name: relevant_companies
attributes.description: Companies or areas for which the document is valid.

attributes.name: source_format
attributes.description: Original Office format of the document content (Word, Excel, PowerPoint, etc.).

attributes.name: language
attributes.description: Language version of the document content.

objs.name: attachment
objs.description: Controlled sub-document attached to a main document, subject to its own versioning and released together with the main document.

attributes.name: version
attributes.description: Current version number of the attachment.

attributes.name: status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the attachment.

objs.name: additional_info
objs.description: Supplementary information object attached to a document that is not subject to the release cycle and can be published directly.

objs.name: change_proposal
objs.description: A proposal for changing an existing document, created without affecting the document content or version history until scheduled for implementation.

attributes.name: status
attributes.description: Current processing status of the change proposal (e.g. created, scheduled, completed).

objs.name: validity_extension_request
objs.description: System-generated request created 30 days before a document's validity expires, triggering a workflow to extend, revise or invalidate the document.

objs.name: override_request
objs.description: Request to invalidate (put out of force) a document and archive it, triggering a workflow for review and approval.

objs.name: reactivation_request
objs.description: Request to reactivate a previously invalidated and archived document, triggering a reactivation workflow.

objs.name: user
objs.description: Individual person who interacts with the system in one or more roles.

attributes.name: role
attributes.description: System role assigned to the user (e.g. Author, Co-Author, Reviewer, Releaser, Translator, Reader).

objs.name: user_group
objs.description: Named group of users used to assign authorizations and distribution memberships.

objs.name: distribution_list
objs.description: List of user groups and individual persons assigned to a document for email notification or acknowledgement upon release.

objs.name: document_template
objs.description: Predefined template associated with a document type, selectable when creating new documents.

objs.name: workflow
objs.description: System-supported process instance that routes tasks through steps such as creation, review and release.

objs.name: electronic_signature
objs.description: Digital signature captured from workflow participants to confirm completion of a workflow step.

objs.name: dashboard
objs.description: User and role-specific view presenting relevant documents, tasks and evaluation reports.

objs.name: client
objs.description: Tenant or organizational unit in a multi-client system where document visibility can be controlled.

evts.name: create_document
evts.description: A new document (information object) is created in the system by selecting a document type and optionally a template.

evts.name: edit_document_content
evts.description: The content of a document is opened and edited using the integrated Office editing client.

evts.name: edit_document_properties
evts.description: Metadata and attributes of a document are maintained or updated in the properties dialog.

evts.name: convert_document_to_pdf
evts.description: After saving, the document is automatically converted to PDF format for web display.

evts.name: start_release_workflow
evts.description: The 3-step release workflow (Creator – Review – Release) is initiated by the author or a co-author.

evts.name: sign_creation_step
evts.description: The registered author signs the creation step as the first step of the release workflow.

evts.name: review_document
evts.description: A reviewer checks the document for technical and/or formal correctness during the review workflow step.

evts.name: reject_document
evts.description: A reviewer or releaser rejects the document during the workflow, canceling the workflow for subsequent participants.

evts.name: release_document
evts.description: A releaser approves and releases the document, making it visible to addressed readers.

evts.name: publish_document
evts.description: After release, the document is automatically published and made visible to readers.

evts.name: create_new_version
evts.description: A new editing version of a released document is created when revisions or changes are initiated.

evts.name: add_attachment
evts.description: A controlled attachment is added to a document, triggering a new version of the main document.

evts.name: modify_attachment
evts.description: An existing attachment is modified, triggering a new version of the associated main document.

evts.name: archive_attachment
evts.description: An attachment is marked for archiving and archived upon release of the next main document version.

evts.name: add_additional_info
evts.description: An additional information object is added to a document without affecting the main document version.

evts.name: delete_additional_info
evts.description: An additional information object is removed from a document without affecting the main document version.

evts.name: create_change_proposal
evts.description: A change proposal is created for an existing released document by a user with author rights.

evts.name: schedule_change_proposal
evts.description: A change proposal is scheduled for implementation, creating a new version of the document.

evts.name: complete_change_proposal
evts.description: The author documents the completion of a change proposal, notifying the proposal creator.

evts.name: create_validity_extension_request
evts.description: The system automatically creates a validity extension request 30 days before the document validity expires.

evts.name: extend_validity
evts.description: The releaser (and optionally author and reviewer) confirm the continued validity of the document, updating the Valid Until date.

evts.name: create_override_request
evts.description: A user with write access creates a request to invalidate a document and start the override workflow.

evts.name: approve_override
evts.description: The releaser (and optionally reviewer) approves the override request, setting the document status to Out of Force.

evts.name: archive_document
evts.description: An invalidated document and its attachments are archived by revoking all authorizations except for the archive group.

evts.name: physically_delete_document
evts.description: After the archive period expires, the archived document is physically deleted from the system.

evts.name: create_reactivation_request
evts.description: The Business Admin group creates a request to reactivate a previously invalidated document.

evts.name: reactivate_document
evts.description: The initiator confirms reactivation, creating a new version of the document and restoring authorizations.

evts.name: distribute_document_by_email
evts.description: Upon release of a new version, users on the distribution list are notified by email.

evts.name: distribute_document_for_acknowledgement
evts.description: Upon release, users on the distribution list are requested by email to actively confirm acknowledgement.

evts.name: confirm_acknowledgement
evts.description: A recipient confirms acknowledgement of a released document version via a workflow task.

evts.name: assign_authorization
evts.description: Read or write authorizations are assigned to user groups or individual persons for a document.

evts.name: translate_document
evts.description: A released document is translated into another language and submitted for review and release.

evts.name: release_translation
evts.description: The translated version of a document is reviewed and released, making it visible in the corresponding language.

evts.name: send_email_notification
evts.description: The system sends an email notification to inform users about workflow tasks, status changes or pending actions.

o2o.description: An Attachment belongs to and is controlled by a main Document.
An Additional Info object is supplementary to a Document.
A Change Proposal belongs to a specific Document.
A Validity Extension Request is linked to the Document whose validity must be checked.
An Override Request is linked to the Document to be invalidated.
A Reactivation Request references the archived Document to be reactivated.
One or more Document Templates are defined per document type and selectable when creating a Document.
A Document can reference another Document (e.g. local extension referencing original).
A User is assigned to one or more User Groups.
A Distribution List is maintained per Document for controlling notification and acknowledgement.
A Distribution List contains User Groups whose members receive document distributions.
A Distribution List can contain individual Users for direct distribution.
A User Group can have subgroups (e.g. location-specific groups assigned to reader groups).
A Document can be made visible or hidden per Client in a multi-client system.
